newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian high court rejects jailed lawyer's appeal.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian high court rejects jailed lawyer's appeal.

text.p: A Tunisian high court has rejected an appeal by a Tunisian lawyer and human rights activist against an eight-year jail sentence imposed for having forged a real estate deal in 1989, his lawyers said on Thursday.
Najib Hasni was detained in June 1994 and sentenced in January 1996. The Cour de Cassation in Tunis on Wednesday confirmed the sentence.

The U.S. state department said in its 1996 report on Tunisia's human rights record that some observers had speculated that the government's motive in prosecuting Hasni was that he had previously defended accused Islamists in court and spoken freely with human rights activists.
The Institute of Human Rights of the French bar association in the City of Bordeaux recently said it would award Hasni a human rights prize.
